pool.text: What is the value of \( (2^3)(3^2) \)?
Solve \( 3x^2 - 5x - 2 = 0 \). Which values of \( x \) are solutions?
What is the horizontal asymptote of \( f(x) = \dfrac{3x^2}{x^2+1} \)?
pool.sol: Since the degree of the numerator equals the degree of the denominator (both degree 2), the horizontal asymptote is the ratio of their leading coefficients: \( y = \dfrac{3}{1} = 3 \). As \( x \to \pm\infty \), \( f(x) = \dfrac{3}{1 + 1/x^2} \to 3 \).

pool.text: If \( f(x) = \dfrac{2x-1}{x+3} \), which is \( f^{-1}(x) \)?
pool.sol: To find the inverse function, set \( y = \dfrac{2x-1}{x+3} \), swap \( x \) and \( y \): \( x = \dfrac{2y-1}{y+3} \). Cross-multiply and solve for \( y \): \( x(y+3) = 2y-1 \implies xy + 3x = 2y - 1 \implies 3x + 1 = 2y - xy \implies 3x + 1 = y(2-x) \implies y = \dfrac{3x+1}{2-x} \). Thus, \( f^{-1}(x) = \dfrac{3x+1}{2-x} \).
